prayerExcerpt.en-US: In quest of a closer retirement, St. Avitus, who had succeeded St. Maximin, soon after resigned the abbacy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Em busca de um retiro mais recolhido, Santo Ávito, que havia sucedido a São Maximino, logo em seguida renunciou ao abadiado.

meta.face: A Frank of peasant stock of about sixty-five, weathered by field and forest, with a brown, outdoor complexion and a LEAN, FLAT, WIDE face with a DISHED, CONCAVE profile — a broad, flat forehead, a SHORT, SCOOPED nose with an UPTURNED tip, WIDE-SET, large, mild, pale-green eyes under sparse, straight grey brows, BROAD, FLAT cheekbones with thin cheeks beneath, a wide, thin-lipped mouth, a SMALL, ROUND chin under a SHORT, ROUGH grey-brown beard; grey-brown hair cropped close around a monastic tonsure; the gaze lowered, gentle and patient.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book tells a native of Orleans, monk at Menat and at Micy with St. Calais, abbot of Micy who resigned to live as a recluse in the Dunois, for whom King Clotaire built a monastery near Châteaudun, and who died about 530; its engraving shows two monks walking in open country. French Wikipedia (Avit de Micy) makes him a son of humble farmers of the Beauce and a lover of the forest solitude. The flat, dish-profiled face is our choice.
